supporting_passages: Soil moisture-based smart irrigation platforms integrate capacitance sensors, ten- siometers, and IoT-controlled drip systems to regulate water delivery in near real time.
links.inference_note: The preceding sentence names soil moisture sensor-based platforms (capacitance sensors, tensiometers), and the cited sentence attributes 20–40% water savings to them.
